definitions.explanation: An unpleasant or difficult experience that often provides a valuable lesson.

examples.japanese: {苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned from past bitter experiences.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The bitter experiences of my youth have shaped who I am today.

notes:
{苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん} refers to difficult experiences that often teach valuable lessons.
